why: The reader names the problem directly in section 5, which they call their biggest confusion: the chart says "מושכים את הכסף אחרי 5 שנים" ("withdrawing the money after 5 years") but the text under it says "משיכה אחרי 6 שנים" ("withdrawal after 6 years").
